g.text: Apply module power with command held zero. U23 holds reset 180-420 ms after actual module supply rises.

g.desc: Apply module power with command held zero. U23 holds reset 180-420 ms after actual module supply rises.

g.text: Raise PGM_RELEASE; 10k / 47uF gives 0.47-0.588 s nominal ramp including pot resistance.

g.text: Accept C210 only with effective C >=22uF at 2.048 V / temperature; measure settling.

g.text: Disable by releasing command first, then removing module power.

g.text: HV_ENABLE low: U22 removes module 5 V. Fault latches off.

g.desc: HV_ENABLE low: U22 removes module 5 V. Fault latches off.

g.text: Either control low: 2N7002 clamps filtered command to 0 V.
